monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_dis_human_synergy_pulse
	}
}

oe_dis_human_synergy_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1440
		current_year <= 1765
		is_ai = no
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			current_month = 1
			current_month = 7
		}
		NOT = { oe_dis_rule_is_off = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		oe_dis_sync_country_synergies = yes
	}
}
